limitations: No full dsh/Electron UI, profile install/disable acceptance or currently running chat-page CSP inspection.
React CodeBlock reproductions use matching component shapes; the extracted settings-row test stubs Input/icons and drives store/event updates.
jsdom is not a layout/canvas font measurement environment; SVG dimensions are fixture-specific.
ResizeObserver is a no-op/counting stub in lifecycle tests and absent in the extracted settings-row race; automatic resize recovery was not measured.
No actual browser/Electron remote-image network request observation; generated href establishes capability only.
No heap snapshot or GC retention proof; observer counts returning to zero do not establish leak freedom.
Structural-switch React failure reachability, full-app boundary placement and isolated streaming-update frequency in real dsh are not established.
Remount and SVG identity changes were observed; visible flicker and interactive zoom/pan resets were not browser-tested.
Manager scheduling counts use injected clocks and stub renderers, not Pele drawing-time benchmarks.
Temporary scripts and outputs are outside the repository; some one-off generators are missing.
Moli not run: prior loopback sandbox denial and approval-stream disconnect; no browser/server started during this document revision.
